## What does this change? / Que change cette pull request ?



## Checklist

- [ ] `mise run check` passes (format, analysis, tests) / passe
- [ ] Tests added or updated / tests ajoutés ou mis à jour
- [ ] Texts shown to users are translated (English required, French welcome) / textes traduits
- [ ] Docs updated if needed / documentation à jour si besoin
- [ ] Version lines updated in the files I touched / lignes de version mises à jour
- [ ] No secret in the code, the tests or the commits / aucun secret
